public_access: No login. Anyone with the URL can read and change the shared diary.
dates: YYYY-MM-DD local calendar dates in Asia/Seoul; delayed means due_date < current Asia/Seoul date and status != done
timestamps: RFC3339 UTC strings with Z suffix; converted to Asia/Seoul for display

review_rules.completed: Count active tasks where status = done
review_rules.delayed: Count active tasks where status != done and due_date < today in Asia/Seoul
review_rules.blocked: Count distinct active tasks with at least one nonempty blocker in work_logs
review_rules.actual_minutes: Sum actual_minutes of work_logs attached to active tasks
review_rules.drilldown: Every review value includes the source task IDs in evidence
